items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S3427

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the tax law and chapter 179 of the laws of 2007,
amending the tax law relating to authorizing the county of Clinton to
impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes,
in relation to extending the expiration of such authorization


 PURPOSE :
To extend the authorization for Clinton County to impose an additional
one percent sales and compensating use taxes for an additional two
year period.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Section 1 - amends clause 36 to subparagraph (i) of the opening
paragraph of section 1210 of the tax law, as amended by chapter 179 of
the laws of 2007 to extend the authority Clinton County to adopt and
amend local laws, ordinances or resolutions imposing such taxes at a
rate which is one percent until November 30, 2011.

Section 2 - provides the net collections from the additional one
percent rate of tax imposed are to be distributed to Clinton County
and are not subject to ant revenue distribution agreement under
section 1262 (c) of the Tax Law with the City of Plattsburgh.

Section 3 - contains effective date.

 EXISTING LAW :
Clause 36 of subparagraph (i) of the opening paragraph of section 1210
of the Tax Law authorizes Clinton County to impose an additional one
percent rate of sales and compensating use taxes for the period
commencing December 1, 2007 and ending November 30, 2009.  The county
currently imposes such additional rate.

 JUSTIFICATION :
The Clinton County Legislature has requested the introduction of
legislation extending their authority to impose and additional one
percent sales and compensating use tax to November 30, 2011.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None to the state.

 LOCAL FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
The county estimates the additional one percent sales tax will
generate $11.8 million.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Extends from November 30, 2009 to November 30, 2011, the expiration of the authorization to the county of Clinton to impose an additional 1% sales and compensating use taxes.
